"Jab mind enlighten ho jata, purani darkness wapas nahi."
Tum wahi ho jo tum sochte.
Bade goals rakho, fail huye toh bhi sabse aage hoge.
"Dream—believe—build."
"Discomfort proof hai—tum grow kar rahe."

"Action bina motivation—bas baat."
